allow_conditional.description: Allow selected capabilities with CONDITIONAL readiness in their required repository evidence to be proposed, subject to all other planner checks. CONDITIONAL does not become READY; ambiguous or unsupported evidence is not made eligible.
allow_conditional.title: Allow Conditional

allowed.description: Explicit nonempty set of acceptable execution modes. No ranking, implicit default or fallback. Compatibility must also satisfy the startup readiness policy; selecting a mode does not execute or authorize anything.
allowed.title: Allowed

require.description: Explicit execution controls that every compatible proposed mode must support. These requirements narrow compatibility; they do not grant operator permissions or attest to a live runtime.
require.title: Require

exclude.description: Exact capability IDs removed after combining include and include_all_ready. Unknown IDs in either include or exclude are refused.
exclude.title: Exclude

include.description: Exact canonical capability IDs explicitly proposed for exposure, for example python:model:predict. No fuzzy matching or implicit dependency exposure.
include.title: Include

include_all_ready.description: Add capabilities assessed READY in the repository readiness report to the requested selection before exclusions. All planner eligibility, interface and execution checks still apply; this grants no publication or operator authority.
include_all_ready.title: Include All Ready

eligibility.description: Readiness eligibility constraints for selected capabilities; cannot replace missing or uncertain evidence.

execution.description: Explicit acceptable execution modes and required controls for compatibility planning, not permission to execute.

interfaces.description: Nonempty requested generated interface set: rest and/or mcp. Planning checks compatibility for every interface; it does not generate, deploy or run them.
interfaces.title: Interfaces

schema_version.description: Version identifier for this exposure planning constraint contract; not operator authorization.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

selection.description: Explicit capability selection proposal; empty defaults do not select every capability.
